decisions.reason: The renamed 518 FLEX builds on an established, well-received trommel platform, so it costs little to carry and has early positive signals, which makes the option worth keeping.
The flail shredder line has its own page and its uncertainty has not yet resolved, and in a capital-goods market adoption takes years, so keeping it remains cheap relative to its option value.
The grinder line is only mentioned and overlaps with the firm's other new grinders, but one year is too short for its value to have resolved, so it is kept while being watched.
The stationary electric fine shredder fits the stated direction toward resource-saving plant solutions, and with no negative evidence its option is kept despite low website visibility.

The green-waste grinder line overlaps with Product C and the firm holds many parallel options, which raises the risk of consolidation, but its value has not yet been shown to fail, so it stays for now.
The single-shaft pre-shredder line has its own page and broadens the stationary portfolio, and its prospects are still open, so keeping the option is justified.
